data.title: Bitcoin and ethereum prices today, Thursday, October 8, 2026: Crypto values fall as oil prices soar
data.description: Bitcoin opened at $83,275.52 on Thursday, October 8, 2026, down 2.7% from Wednesday's open. As of 7:11 a.m. ET this morning, bitcoin moved down to $82,347.48. Ethereum opened at $2,573.30, down 4.6% from Wednesday's opening price. The price of ethereum moved down further this morning to $2,532.42 as of 7:11 a.m. ET.
